title: The Canteen's SECRET Stash Exposed 🤖 Ep.2

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1 p.m. The crisis was 'solved.' Jamal Chacha saved the day. [beat] Then Nix opened the staff room fridge. [beat] Full. [beat] FULL of samosas.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: TWO HUNDRED samosas! [beat] Choto Mia said FINISHED! [beat] So who… hid ALL of these?!

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: Fridge? What fridge? [beat] I don't even know where the staff room IS!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: He knows. [beat] They ALL know. [beat] This goes… all the way to the top.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Receipts. Choto ordered HALF his usual stock this week. [beat] Deliberately.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So the shortage… was PLANNED. [beat] Starve the school… [beat] then sell at double price.

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: Okay! OKAY! [beat] Business was slow! One tiny crisis and suddenly everyone NEEDS samosas! [beat] I got… excited.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: So while WE starved… [beat] YOU got rich? [beat] Interesting. [beat] Very interesting.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: PRICE GOUGING! In OUR canteen! [beat] Wait till I tell EVERYONE. [beat] Twice!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Choto Mia. [beat] My office. [beat] Bring the receipts… [beat] ALL of them.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Beta, in Dubai we say: [beat] fool me once… [beat] I open my own canteen. NEXT DOOR.

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: NOT next door! [beat] I'll sell at HALF price! [beat] FREE chutney! [beat] MERCY!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Justice tastes better than samosas. [beat] Almost. [beat] Follow for the next story — [beat] because next week… [beat] someone steals an ENTIRE exam paper.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The canteen survived. [beat] Choto's conscience… [beat] is still missing.
